Name: Animals Enhanced
Author: justrecht
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Animals Enhanced[/b][/size]
[i]Give your farm animals personality and realistic responses[/i][/center]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][color=#ff6b6b]🔨 Tool Response System[/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Farm animals and pets now [b]respond when attacked[/b] with tools (sword, axe, hoe, pickaxe, sickle)[/*]
[*][b]Watering can is safe[/b] - won't hurt your animals[/*]
[*]Being hit [b]significantly reduces affection points[/b][/*]
[*]Animals show hurt emotions, make sounds, and display warning messages[/*]
[*][b]Pets run away scared[/b] when hit[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#4ecdc4]🎭 Animal Personalities[/color][/size]
Each animal gets one of [b]6 unique personality types[/b] that affect their behavior and production:

[list]
[*][b]Cheerful[/b] 🌟 - Active and happy, shows hearts, moves quickly | [color=#95e1d3]+15% quality bonus[/color][/*]
[*][b]Calm[/b] 😌 - Peaceful and slow-moving, rarely emotional | [color=#95e1d3]+10% quality bonus[/color][/*]
[*][b]Nervous[/b] 😰 - Skittish, runs away from farmers, erratic movement | [color=#ff6b6b]-10% quality penalty[/color][/*]
[*][b]Grumpy[/b] 😠 - Independent, shows angry emotes, consistent despite mood | [color=#95e1d3]+5% quality bonus[/color][/*]
[*][b]Lazy[/b] 😴 - Very slow, shows sleep emotes, stops frequently | [color=#ff6b6b]-5% quality penalty[/color][/*]
[*][b]Playful[/b] 🎈 - Energetic, jumps around, approaches farmer | [color=#95e1d3]+20% quality bonus[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#f9ca24]🌟 Quality Production System[/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Produce quality [b]strongly affected by personality[/b][/*]
[*]Combines personality bonus/penalty with friendship and happiness[/*]
[*]Possible qualities: Normal, Silver, Gold, [b]Iridium[/b][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][color=#6c5ce7]🐾 Personality-Based Behaviors[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Unique movement patterns[/b] for each personality type[/*]
[*][b]Emotional expressions[/b] (emotes) based on mood[/*]
[*][b]Interaction behaviors[/b] with the farmer[/*]
[*]All behaviors feel [b]natural and vanilla-friendly[/b][/*]
[/list]

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Download this mod[/*]
[*]Extract to your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]SMAPI 3.0.0+[/b][/*]
[*]Compatible with most other mods[/*]
[*]Safe to add/remove from existing saves[/*]
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]This is a BETA release (v0.1.0-beta)[/b][/size]
Please report any bugs or suggestions in the posts section!
